newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Green groups call for Amcor boycott.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Green groups call for Amcor boycott.

text.p: Green groups called on Wednesday for a consumer boycott of Australia's largest paper producer, Amcor Ltd, in protest against the group's use of woodchips from native forests to make fine-grade papers.

"High conservation-value forests in Tasmania and Victoria (states), including old-growth (trees) and endangered-species habitat, are being woodchipped for Amcor to make paper," said a statement issued by the four green groups.
Environment Victoria, Friends of the Earth, the Native Forest Network and The Wilderness Society called on consumers to boycott Amcor's Reflex copy paper in favour of recycled papers.
